order: Rules are checked <accent>top to bottom, the first match wins</accent> — not the most specific one. A rule below one that already matched never runs, so the order here is the logic.

broken.title: The config does not match the schema
broken.description: The file on the device is untouched. Rules cannot be shown — first we need to understand what is wrong with it.

empty.title: No rules
empty.description: All traffic takes the default route: route.final or the first outbound.
